scope: Saved predictions only. No inference, training, threshold tuning, source/GT changes or GPU use.

definitions.operating_match: Frozen R03 confidence; score descending; same-class unmatched GT at max IoU>=0.5; higher GT index tie-break, identical to original evaluator.
definitions.fp_overlap_primary: A frozen-threshold FP overlaps any source excluded bbox with IoU>=0.5; each FP counted once.
fp_overlap_variants: prediction center inside any excluded bbox, inclusive
center rule excluding source types text and component text
definitions.low_confidence_candidate: GT missed at frozen confidence, any saved same-class prediction with IoU>=0.5. Saved post-NMS raw floor0.001. Best-score candidate recorded.
definitions.low_confidence_unique_check: Extend score-ordered one-to-one matching to saved floor and count newly recovered GT.
definitions.causality: Overlap does not establish annotation error or justify ignoring known non-target types. Candidate existence does not guarantee improved performance at lower confidence.
